thesis: Dignity belongs to people independently of cognitive performance and others must support their agency where possible.

ideas.statement: Distinguish moral agency from being owed protection; domain-specific limits do not authorize total control, and carers need shared support rather than invisible sacrifice.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: No individual clinical or legal procedures are prescribed; extreme uncertainty needs expertise, previous wishes and safeguards, while risk prevention is not punishment.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: No individual clinical or legal procedures are prescribed; extreme uncertainty needs expertise, previous wishes and safeguards, while risk prevention is not punishment.

audit.notes: All batch units analyzed directly; practical cases and normative limits preserved.
